officialTitle: Arson resulting in injury to another; penalty

names.es: Incendio provocado que causa daño corporal

en: Arson resulting in injury to another; penalty
es: Arson resulting in injury to another; penalty
zh: Arson resulting in injury to another; penalty

en.plainSummary: Committing arson that results in bodily harm to a firefighter or any other person. Intent to cause injury is not required.
en.degreeContext: First-degree misdemeanor: ordinarily up to one year in jail and a $1,000 fine. A separate sentence is possible for arson committed in the same episode; an arson conviction is unnecessary for this injury charge.

es.plainSummary: Cometer un incendio provocado que causa daño corporal a un bombero u otra persona. No se exige intención de causar lesiones.
es.degreeContext: Delito menor de primer grado: normalmente hasta un año de cárcel y multa de $1,000. Puede imponerse otra pena por el incendio provocado en el mismo episodio; no se exige condena por incendio para este cargo por lesiones.

zh.plainSummary: 实施纵火并造成消防员或其他人身体伤害。无须有造成伤害的意图。
zh.degreeContext: 一级轻罪：通常最高一年监禁及1,000美元罚金。 同一事件的纵火罪可另行判刑；本伤害罪无需先就纵火罪定罪。

officialTitle: Arson resulting in injury to another; penalty

definition.name: Arson resulting in great bodily harm, permanent disability or disfigurement

names.es: Incendio provocado que causa daño grave, discapacidad o desfiguración permanente
names.zh: 纵火造成严重伤害、永久残疾或永久毁容

en: Arson resulting in injury to another; penalty
es: Arson resulting in injury to another; penalty
zh: Arson resulting in injury to another; penalty

en.plainSummary: Committing arson that results in great bodily harm, permanent disability or permanent disfigurement to a firefighter or another person. Intent to cause injury is not required.
en.degreeContext: Second-degree felony: ordinarily up to 15 years in prison and a $10,000 fine. A separate sentence is possible for arson committed in the same episode; an arson conviction is unnecessary for this injury charge.

es.plainSummary: Cometer un incendio provocado que causa daño corporal grave, discapacidad permanente o desfiguración permanente a un bombero u otra persona. No se exige intención de causar lesiones.
es.degreeContext: Delito grave de segundo grado: normalmente hasta 15 años de prisión y multa de $10,000. Puede imponerse otra pena por el incendio provocado en el mismo episodio; no se exige condena por incendio para este cargo por lesiones.

zh.plainSummary: 实施纵火导致消防员或其他人严重身体伤害、永久残疾或永久毁容。无须有造成伤害的意图。
zh.degreeContext: 二级重罪：通常最高15年监禁及10,000美元罚金。 同一事件的纵火罪可另行判刑；本伤害罪无需先就纵火罪定罪。

officialTitle: Preventing or obstructing extinguishment of fire

definition.name: Preventing or obstructing extinguishment of fire: equipment or facilities

names.es: Obstrucción de la extinción de incendios: equipos o instalaciones

en: Preventing or obstructing extinguishment of fire
es: Preventing or obstructing extinguishment of fire
zh: Preventing or obstructing extinguishment of fire

en.plainSummary: Willfully and maliciously injuring, destroying, removing or otherwise interfering with the use of instruments or facilities used to detect, report, suppress or extinguish fire.
en.degreeContext: Third-degree felony: ordinarily up to five years in prison and a $5,000 fine.

es.plainSummary: Dañar, destruir o retirar deliberadamente y con malicia medios o instalaciones para detectar, comunicar, controlar o extinguir incendios, o interferir con su uso.
es.degreeContext: Delito grave de tercer grado: normalmente hasta cinco años de prisión y multa de $5,000.

zh.plainSummary: 故意且恶意损坏、破坏、移走或以其他方式妨碍用于探测、报告、控制或扑灭火灾的器材或设施的使用。
zh.degreeContext: 三级重罪：通常最高五年监禁及5,000美元罚金。

officialTitle: Preventing or obstructing extinguishment of fire

definition.name: Preventing or obstructing extinguishment of fire: interference with a firefighter

names.es: Obstrucción de la extinción de incendios: interferencia con un bombero

en: Preventing or obstructing extinguishment of fire
es: Preventing or obstructing extinguishment of fire
zh: Preventing or obstructing extinguishment of fire

en.plainSummary: Willfully or unreasonably interfering with, hindering or assaulting a firefighter on duty, or attempting to interfere with or hinder the firefighter.
en.degreeContext: Third-degree felony: ordinarily up to five years in prison and a $5,000 fine.

es.plainSummary: Interferir deliberadamente o de forma irrazonable con un bombero en servicio, obstaculizarlo o agredirlo, o intentar interferir u obstaculizarlo.
es.degreeContext: Delito grave de tercer grado: normalmente hasta cinco años de prisión y multa de $5,000.

zh.plainSummary: 故意或不合理地妨碍、阻挠或袭击执行职务的消防员，或试图妨碍或阻挠消防员。
zh.degreeContext: 三级重罪：通常最高五年监禁及5,000美元罚金。

en.plainSummary: Making or circulating a false fire alarm, or causing it to be made or circulated, without reasonable cause.
en.degreeContext: First-degree misdemeanor: ordinarily up to one year in jail and a $1,000 fine. The misdemeanor applies to the first conviction. A second or subsequent conviction under this section is a third-degree felony, ordinarily up to five years and a $5,000 fine.

es.plainSummary: Emitir o difundir una falsa alarma de incendio, o hacer que se emita o difunda, sin causa razonable.
es.degreeContext: Delito menor de primer grado: normalmente hasta un año de cárcel y multa de $1,000. El delito menor corresponde a la primera condena. Una segunda condena o posterior por esta sección es delito grave de tercer grado, normalmente hasta cinco años y multa de $5,000.

zh.plainSummary: 无合理理由发出或传播虚假火警，或促使他人发出或传播。
zh.degreeContext: 一级轻罪：通常最高一年监禁及1,000美元罚金。 初次定罪为轻罪。依本条第二次或之后定罪为三级重罪，通常最高五年监禁及5,000美元罚金。

officialTitle: Criminal mischief; penalties; penalty for minor

definition.name: Criminal mischief at a place of worship

names.es: Daño malicioso a un lugar de culto

en: Criminal mischief; penalties; penalty for minor
es: Criminal mischief; penalties; penalty for minor
zh: Criminal mischief; penalties; penalty for minor

en.plainSummary: Willfully and maliciously defacing, injuring or damaging a place of worship or a religious article inside it, causing more than $200 in damage.
en.degreeContext: Third-degree felony: ordinarily up to five years in prison and a $5,000 fine. The court may order payment for damage. If graffiti is involved, additional fine minimums are $250, $500 and $1,000 for first, second and later convictions, subject to inability to pay. At least 40 community-service hours are required and, if possible, at least 100 hours of graffiti removal; special juvenile rules may apply.

es.plainSummary: Desfigurar, lesionar o dañar deliberadamente y con malicia un lugar de culto o artículo religioso en su interior, causando daños superiores a $200.
es.degreeContext: Delito grave de tercer grado: normalmente hasta cinco años de prisión y multa de $5,000. El tribunal puede exigir el pago del daño. Si hubo grafitis, las multas adicionales mínimas son $250, $500 y $1,000 en la primera, segunda y posteriores condenas, salvo incapacidad de pago. Se exigen al menos 40 horas de servicio comunitario y, si es posible, al menos 100 de eliminación de grafitis; existen reglas para menores.

zh.plainSummary: 故意且恶意污损或损坏礼拜场所或其内宗教物品，造成超过200美元的损失。
zh.degreeContext: 三级重罪：通常最高五年监禁及5,000美元罚金。 法院可判令赔偿损失。涉及涂鸦时，首犯、再次及之后定罪的附加罚金下限分别为250、500和1,000美元，无力支付时可免。须至少40小时社区服务，并在可能时至少100小时清除涂鸦；未成年人另有规定。

officialTitle: Criminal mischief; penalties; penalty for minor

definition.name: Criminal mischief against a memorial or historic property

names.es: Daño malicioso a un monumento conmemorativo o bien histórico
names.zh: 恶意损毁纪念物或历史财产

en: Criminal mischief; penalties; penalty for minor
es: Criminal mischief; penalties; penalty for minor
zh: Criminal mischief; penalties; penalty for minor

en.plainSummary: Without owner consent, willfully and maliciously defacing, injuring or damaging a memorial or officially designated historic property as defined in §806.135(1), with damage exceeding $200.
en.degreeContext: Third-degree felony: ordinarily up to five years in prison and a $5,000 fine. The court must order restitution including the full repair or replacement cost. If graffiti is involved, additional fine minimums are $250, $500 and $1,000 for first, second and later convictions, subject to inability to pay. At least 40 community-service hours are required and, if possible, at least 100 hours of graffiti removal; special juvenile rules may apply.

es.plainSummary: Sin consentimiento del propietario, desfigurar o dañar deliberadamente y con malicia un monumento conmemorativo definido por ley o bien oficialmente designado histórico, con daños superiores a $200.
es.degreeContext: Delito grave de tercer grado: normalmente hasta cinco años de prisión y multa de $5,000. El tribunal debe ordenar restitución que incluya el costo total de reparación o reemplazo. Si hubo grafitis, las multas adicionales mínimas son $250, $500 y $1,000 en la primera, segunda y posteriores condenas, salvo incapacidad de pago. Se exigen al menos 40 horas de servicio comunitario y, si es posible, al menos 100 de eliminación de grafitis; existen reglas para menores.

zh.plainSummary: 未经所有者同意，故意且恶意污损或破坏第806.135(1)条定义的纪念物或正式指定的历史财产，造成超过200美元的损失。
zh.degreeContext: 三级重罪：通常最高五年监禁及5,000美元罚金。 法院须判令赔偿，包括全部修理或更换费用。 涉及涂鸦时，首犯、再次及之后定罪的附加罚金下限分别为250、500和1,000美元，无力支付时可免。须至少40小时社区服务，并在可能时至少100小时清除涂鸦；未成年人另有规定。

officialTitle: Criminal mischief; penalties; penalty for minor

definition.name: Intentional property damage during unlawful occupancy or trespass

names.es: Daño intencional durante ocupación ilícita o entrada sin derecho
names.zh: 非法占用或擅入期间故意损坏财产

en: Criminal mischief; penalties; penalty for minor
es: Criminal mischief; penalties; penalty for minor
zh: Criminal mischief; penalties; penalty for minor

en.plainSummary: Unlawfully detaining, occupying or trespassing upon a residential dwelling or commercial real property and intentionally damaging that property, causing at least $1,000 in damage.
en.degreeContext: Second-degree felony: ordinarily up to 15 years in prison and a $10,000 fine. The court may order payment for damage. If graffiti is involved, additional fine minimums are $250, $500 and $1,000 for first, second and later convictions, subject to inability to pay. At least 40 community-service hours are required and, if possible, at least 100 hours of graffiti removal; special juvenile rules may apply.

es.plainSummary: Retener, ocupar o invadir ilícitamente una vivienda o inmueble comercial y causarle intencionalmente daños de al menos $1,000.
es.degreeContext: Delito grave de segundo grado: normalmente hasta 15 años de prisión y multa de $10,000. El tribunal puede exigir el pago del daño. Si hubo grafitis, las multas adicionales mínimas son $250, $500 y $1,000 en la primera, segunda y posteriores condenas, salvo incapacidad de pago. Se exigen al menos 40 horas de servicio comunitario y, si es posible, al menos 100 de eliminación de grafitis; existen reglas para menores.

zh.plainSummary: 非法扣占、占用或擅自进入住宅或商业不动产，并故意损坏该处，造成至少1,000美元损失。
zh.degreeContext: 二级重罪：通常最高15年监禁及10,000美元罚金。 法院可判令赔偿损失。涉及涂鸦时，首犯、再次及之后定罪的附加罚金下限分别为250、500和1,000美元，无力支付时可免。须至少40小时社区服务，并在可能时至少100小时清除涂鸦；未成年人另有规定。

officialTitle: Criminal mischief; penalties; penalty for minor

definition.name: Criminal mischief involving a public telephone

en: Criminal mischief; penalties; penalty for minor
es: Criminal mischief; penalties; penalty for minor
zh: Criminal mischief; penalties; penalty for minor

en.plainSummary: Without owner consent, willfully destroying or substantially damaging a public telephone or its apparatus, rendering the telephone inoperative or opening its body. A conspicuous notice of this law and its penalties must be posted on or near the instrument and visible to the public at the time.
en.degreeContext: Third-degree felony: ordinarily up to five years in prison and a $5,000 fine. The court may order payment for damage. If graffiti is involved, additional fine minimums are $250, $500 and $1,000 for first, second and later convictions, subject to inability to pay. At least 40 community-service hours are required and, if possible, at least 100 hours of graffiti removal; special juvenile rules may apply.

es.plainSummary: Sin consentimiento del propietario, destruir deliberadamente o dañar sustancialmente un teléfono público o su equipo, dejándolo inoperante o abriendo su carcasa. Debe haber en el aparato o cerca un aviso destacado de la norma y sus sanciones, visible al público en ese momento.
es.degreeContext: Delito grave de tercer grado: normalmente hasta cinco años de prisión y multa de $5,000. El tribunal puede exigir el pago del daño. Si hubo grafitis, las multas adicionales mínimas son $250, $500 y $1,000 en la primera, segunda y posteriores condenas, salvo incapacidad de pago. Se exigen al menos 40 horas de servicio comunitario y, si es posible, al menos 100 de eliminación de grafitis; existen reglas para menores.

zh.plainSummary: 未经所有者同意，故意破坏或严重损坏公共电话或其设备，使电话无法使用或导致机壳打开。当时须在电话上或附近张贴公众可见的醒目法律及处罚告示。
zh.degreeContext: 三级重罪：通常最高五年监禁及5,000美元罚金。 法院可判令赔偿损失。涉及涂鸦时，首犯、再次及之后定罪的附加罚金下限分别为250、500和1,000美元，无力支付时可免。须至少40小时社区服务，并在可能时至少100小时清除涂鸦；未成年人另有规定。

officialTitle: Destroying or demolishing a memorial or historic property

definition.name: Destroying or demolishing a memorial or historic property

names.es: Destrucción o demolición de un monumento conmemorativo o bien histórico
names.zh: 毁坏或拆毁纪念物或历史财产

en: Destroying or demolishing a memorial or historic property
es: Destroying or demolishing a memorial or historic property
zh: Destroying or demolishing a memorial or historic property

en.plainSummary: Willfully and maliciously destroying, demolishing or pulling down a statutorily defined memorial or officially designated historic property without owner authorization. This branch does not specify a dollar threshold.
en.degreeContext: Second-degree felony: ordinarily up to 15 years in prison and a $10,000 fine. The court must order restitution including the full repair or replacement cost.

es.plainSummary: Destruir, demoler o derribar deliberadamente y con malicia un monumento conmemorativo definido por ley o bien oficialmente designado histórico sin autorización del propietario. Este apartado no exige una cuantía determinada.
es.degreeContext: Delito grave de segundo grado: normalmente hasta 15 años de prisión y multa de $10,000. El tribunal debe ordenar restitución que incluya el costo total de reparación o reemplazo.

zh.plainSummary: 未经所有者授权，故意且恶意摧毁、拆除或拉倒法定纪念物或正式指定的历史财产。本款未设金额门槛。
zh.degreeContext: 二级重罪：通常最高15年监禁及10,000美元罚金。 法院须判令赔偿，包括全部修理或更换费用。

officialTitle: Art works in public buildings; willful damage; unauthorized removal; penalties

definition.name: Damage or unauthorized removal of art in a public building: $200 or less

names.es: Daño o retiro no autorizado de arte en edificio público: $200 o menos
names.zh: 损坏或擅自移走公共建筑内的艺术品： 不超过200美元

en: Art works in public buildings; willful damage; unauthorized removal; penalties
es: Art works in public buildings; willful damage; unauthorized removal; penalties
zh: Art works in public buildings; willful damage; unauthorized removal; penalties

en.plainSummary: Willfully destroying, mutilating, defacing or injuring a work of art displayed in a public building, or removing it without authority. The restoration cost in labor and supplies, or the replacement value, is $200 or less.
en.degreeContext: Second-degree misdemeanor: ordinarily up to 60 days in jail and a $500 fine.

es.plainSummary: Destruir, mutilar, desfigurar o dañar deliberadamente una obra de arte expuesta en un edificio público, o retirarla sin autorización. El costo de restauración en mano de obra y materiales, o el valor de reemplazo, es de $200 o menos.
es.degreeContext: Delito menor de segundo grado: normalmente hasta 60 días de cárcel y multa de $500.

zh.plainSummary: 故意破坏、损毁、污损或损伤公共建筑内展出的艺术品，或未经授权将其移走。 修复所需人工和材料费用或替换价值为 不超过200美元。
zh.degreeContext: 二级轻罪：通常最高60天监禁及500美元罚金。

officialTitle: Art works in public buildings; willful damage; unauthorized removal; penalties

definition.name: Damage or unauthorized removal of art in a public building: over $200 but under $1,000

names.es: Daño o retiro no autorizado de arte en edificio público: más de $200 y menos de $1,000
names.zh: 损坏或擅自移走公共建筑内的艺术品： 超过200但低于1,000美元

en: Art works in public buildings; willful damage; unauthorized removal; penalties
es: Art works in public buildings; willful damage; unauthorized removal; penalties
zh: Art works in public buildings; willful damage; unauthorized removal; penalties

en.plainSummary: Willfully destroying, mutilating, defacing or injuring a work of art displayed in a public building, or removing it without authority. The restoration cost in labor and supplies, or the replacement value, is over $200 but under $1,000.
en.degreeContext: First-degree misdemeanor: ordinarily up to one year in jail and a $1,000 fine.

es.plainSummary: Destruir, mutilar, desfigurar o dañar deliberadamente una obra de arte expuesta en un edificio público, o retirarla sin autorización. El costo de restauración en mano de obra y materiales, o el valor de reemplazo, es de más de $200 y menos de $1,000.
es.degreeContext: Delito menor de primer grado: normalmente hasta un año de cárcel y multa de $1,000.

zh.plainSummary: 故意破坏、损毁、污损或损伤公共建筑内展出的艺术品，或未经授权将其移走。 修复所需人工和材料费用或替换价值为 超过200但低于1,000美元。
zh.degreeContext: 一级轻罪：通常最高一年监禁及1,000美元罚金。

officialTitle: Art works in public buildings; willful damage; unauthorized removal; penalties

definition.name: Damage or unauthorized removal of art in a public building: $1,000 or more

names.es: Daño o retiro no autorizado de arte en edificio público: $1,000 o más
names.zh: 损坏或擅自移走公共建筑内的艺术品： 至少1,000美元

en: Art works in public buildings; willful damage; unauthorized removal; penalties
es: Art works in public buildings; willful damage; unauthorized removal; penalties
zh: Art works in public buildings; willful damage; unauthorized removal; penalties

en.plainSummary: Willfully destroying, mutilating, defacing or injuring a work of art displayed in a public building, or removing it without authority. The restoration cost in labor and supplies, or the replacement value, is $1,000 or more.
en.degreeContext: Third-degree felony: ordinarily up to five years in prison and a $5,000 fine.

es.plainSummary: Destruir, mutilar, desfigurar o dañar deliberadamente una obra de arte expuesta en un edificio público, o retirarla sin autorización. El costo de restauración en mano de obra y materiales, o el valor de reemplazo, es de $1,000 o más.
es.degreeContext: Delito grave de tercer grado: normalmente hasta cinco años de prisión y multa de $5,000.

zh.plainSummary: 故意破坏、损毁、污损或损伤公共建筑内展出的艺术品，或未经授权将其移走。 修复所需人工和材料费用或替换价值为 至少1,000美元。
zh.degreeContext: 三级重罪：通常最高五年监禁及5,000美元罚金。
